systems.owner: Ministry of Interior; Gambia Immigration Department
systems.tiers: seven designated enrolment centres in the Greater Banjul Area from 4 August 2026 (Kanifing ID Card Centre, Banjul Immigration HQ, Bundung and Brusubi police station ID card centres, Abuko and Sanyang immigration offices, Brikama ID Card Centre); extended to Sibanor and Jarra Soma on 7 September, Barra, Kerewan, Farafenni and Kaur on 11 September, Janjanbureh, Basse and Fatoto on 21 September 2026

note: Identity card enrolment schedule and fees; a Gambian birth certificate is one accepted supporting document. Nothing on how births or deaths are registered.
